card.name: Inside web addresses before file endings
card.fires_on: Pieces of a URL or file path just before an extension or query, such as /index, ?, or a partial page name before .html or .cfm.

modes.label: Path piece before .html/.cfm
modes.description: A page-name piece such as index, int, or get right before the file extension.

modes.label: Query mark in a URL
modes.description: A question mark that starts the parameters after a script name.

modes.label: Code include path
modes.description: The quote or equals sign in a file include in page code.
modes.example: from Penelope Leach, Ph.D. <%@ include file<<=">>penelope_pulldown.jsp"%

card.plain: It fires on the broken-up parts of website addresses, just before the page ending like .html or the query part.
